scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && dotnet format ../backend/EmployeeCrud.slnx --verify-no-changes && dotnet test ../backend/EmployeeCrud.slnx
scripts.coverage: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('../backend/TestResults/coverage',{recursive:true,force:true})" && dotnet test ../backend/EmployeeCrud.slnx --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --results-directory ../backend/TestResults/coverage && dotnet tool run reportgenerator "-reports:../backend/TestResults/coverage/**/coverage.cobertura.xml" "-targetdir:../backend/TestResults/coverage-report" "-reporttypes:TextSummary;Html" && node -e "process.stdout.write(require('node:fs').readFileSync('../backend/TestResults/coverage-report/Summary.txt','utf8'))"
